title: Transfer Ownership with std::move
learning_objective: Transfer unique ownership by using an actual std::move call in the initialization of the new owner.
instructions: Fix the program so second takes ownership from player using std::move(player). Submit the complete program.
hints: The new owner should be initialized from an xvalue produced from player.
explanation: std::move does not move an object by itself; it produces an xvalue expression that allows the move constructor of std::unique_ptr to transfer ownership. The AST check verifies that second is actually initialized from std::move(player).
